items.text: Fix scientists now correctly favor nearby cover and avoid getting stuck when navmesh tiles rebuild or when pathfinding already has a valid polyref.
Prevent agents from getting stuck when walking exactly along a navmesh edge and deduplicate polyref state.
Use dtCorridor for smoother path following and stop agents wedging in navmesh corners.
Fix NavMeshAgent pause handling crash (IsPaused collection-modified exception).
Fix tiger charging forever at the bottom of vine trees.
Add break‑apart gibs to wooden loot crates used by DM Construction Resources, Res, Medical and Food, with correct size and material.
Wire DM Tier2 lootbox gibs to its own material so tier markings stay visible when the crate breaks.
Enable read/write on primitive lootbox gibs to allow proper spawning.
Fix ModularCar decay damage server error caused by vehicle pooling.
Show fuel, start engine, and stop engine options only to the driver, matching other vehicles.
Livestock now retain parent information and a new CompletePregnancy console variable added for debugging pregnancies.
Fix missing inspector arguments, add tile prefabs, character preview, and a toggle on the character creator page.
Implement fixed‑size cells for flex grids, removing the need to compute gaps and column counts.
Fixed character creator page setup issues.
Corrected lingering occlusion hide delay to reliably wait 5 seconds before hiding on client.
Ammo display now hides bullets for the glass AK based on current ammo count.
Boat fuel interaction bug fixed, preventing unexpected fuel loss.
Thrown darts now correctly use pooling, improving leaderboard reliability.
Flashlight weapon refreshed: new animator, updated viewmodel, prefab clean‑up and corrected animation events.
Infant animals now stay close to their mother, preventing them from wandering off.
Monument avoidance now uses the PreventBuildingMonumentTag registry for more accurate building restrictions.
Added socket placement support for animal fences and gates, improving fence construction.
Enhanced vehicle pooling resets to ensure a clean state after respawn.
Reduced wooden loot crate gib count from 90 to 22 for better performance.
Fixed AI navigation: find closest edge now works, scientists correctly favor cover near walls, and agents no longer get stuck when navmesh tiles rebuild.
Improved pathfinding: agents use dtCorridor for smoother following and avoid getting wedged in navmesh corners.
Resolved tiger AI charging indefinitely at the base of vine trees.
Fixed server error in ModularCar decay damage caused by vehicle pooling.
Boat interaction UI now only shows fuel and engine controls to the driver.
Livestock now retain parent information and include a debug console variable for completing pregnancies.
Infant animals remain close to their mother.
Enabled read/write access on primitive loot box gibs, fixing related loot issues.
Corrected pooling logic for pool balls, preventing incorrect behavior.
Enabled pooling for thrown darts, improving performance and consistency.
Glass AK now hides bullet models when ammo is depleted.
Fixed blocker mesh issues and switched monument avoidance to use the PreventBuildingMonumentTag registry.
Added animal fence/gate placement module and introduced new S2P monuments such as military tunnel, oilrig, and launch site.
Re‑enabled unsafe scripting access for clients.
Adjusted entity flag toggles to resolve post‑change issues.

2026-08-19.summary:
### NPC & AI
- Fixed AI navigation: find closest edge now works, scientists correctly favor cover near walls, and agents no longer get stuck when navmesh tiles rebuild.
- Improved pathfinding: agents use dtCorridor for smoother following and avoid getting wedged in navmesh corners.
- Resolved tiger AI charging indefinitely at the base of vine trees.

### Vehicles
- Fixed server error in ModularCar decay damage caused by vehicle pooling.
- Boat interaction UI now only shows fuel and engine controls to the driver.

### Animals
- Livestock now retain parent information and include a debug console variable for completing pregnancies.
- Infant animals remain close to their mother.

### Items & Weapons
- Enabled read/write access on primitive loot box gibs, fixing related loot issues.
- Corrected pooling logic for pool balls, preventing incorrect behavior.
- Enabled pooling for thrown darts, improving performance and consistency.
- Glass AK now hides bullet models when ammo is depleted.

### Monuments & Structures
- Fixed blocker mesh issues and switched monument avoidance to use the PreventBuildingMonumentTag registry.
- Added animal fence/gate placement module and introduced new S2P monuments such as military tunnel, oilrig, and launch site.

### Gameplay & Systems
- Re‑enabled unsafe scripting access for clients.
- Adjusted entity flag toggles to resolve post‑change issues.

2026-08-17.summary:
### Animals & Breeding
- All livestock animals now have correct genders and breeding state machine, fixing the issue where every animal was female.
- Bull prefab added, introducing bulls as a new breedable livestock animal.

### Items & Equipment
- Medical honey bandage now correctly triggers its healing effects.
- Water bucket UI fixed so players can transfer water into a held bucket.
- Battery items now properly receive additional data via client RPC.

### UI & Server Connectivity
- Nexus connect modal UI bugs fixed: map button now enables, map no longer squishes, and overall modal stability improved.
- Servers with Nexus enabled are now tagged with "nexuszone", hidden from the server list by default, and expose Nexus info in A2S rules.
- MaxPlayers count displayed correctly after recent changes.
- UI rows alignment corrected, removing the left offset on non-keyframable rows.

### Vehicles
- Vehicle pooling now detaches runtime‑parented children before pooling, preventing NRE spamming.

### Gameplay & World
- Underwater Labs windows refraction texture fixed, improving visibility inside labs.
